simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶשְׁנָב (H822) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֶשְׁנָב (ʼeshnâb) means a latticed window First listed occurrence: Judg 5 28.

definitions.full: H822. eshnab אֶשְׁנָב noun [masculine] window-lattice ( אשנב Ecclus 42:11); Ecclus 7; absolute ׳א Judg 5:28 ; suffix ׳אֶשְׁנַבִּ Prov 7:6 (both || חַלּוֺן ).
definitions.rootNote: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices);
